lotteryDraw.title: Lottery Draw
lotteryDraw.description: Win or lose! Set win ratio and draw lots one by one
lotteryDraw.participantsHint: Names will be shown on the lot cards

whatIs.title: What is Lottery Draw?
whatIs.description: A random drawing tool with customizable win/lose ratios. Perfect for penalty selection, gift raffles, and duty assignment. Draw one by one for suspense or all at once for quick results.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Set total lots and number of winners.
Choose 'One by One' or 'All at Once' mode.
Click each lot to reveal the result.

tips.title: Tips
items: Set custom prizes for 1st/2nd/3rd place tiered prizes.
One-by-one mode builds excitement at parties.
Hide results then reveal all at once for a surprise.

items.q: Can a drawn lot come up again?
items.a: No, drawn lots are removed. Only remaining lots are available (without replacement).

items.q: Can I customize the win ratio?
items.a: Yes, freely set total and winner count. E.g., 3 out of 10 = 30% chance.
